result.evidence_quote: This study revealed significant variations in seasonal epidemic period and age-specific distributions across influenza subtypes/lineages, as well as a marked disruption of influenza activity due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
result.rationale: The study focuses on influenza epidemiology, seasonal patterns, and age-specific viral distributions. It does not address brain or neural mechanisms, neurological disease, cognition, neural injury, or neurological treatments or biomarkers.
